target_customer: AI labs and healthcare or biopharma teams building agents for clinical tasks
problem: Healthcare AI agents struggle with multi-step clinical work in systems like EHR and PACS. Theora supplies expert datasets, rubrics and simulated environments to train them.
business_model: Data and RL environment sales to AI developers, pricing not stated
product_category: Training data and RL environments for healthcare AI agents

founders.name: Larissa Tyagi
previous_startups: Louiza (legal entity behind Theora, injury-prevention software for sports teams)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists her as a software engineer at Apple.

competitors.name: Mechanize
competitors.what: RL environments for agents, mainly coding
competitors.traction_then: Named by TechCrunch as a leading new RL environment startup

competitors.name: Prime Intellect
competitors.what: RL environments and tooling for smaller developers

technical_complexity.rationale: Building FHIR-native EHR and PACS simulations with de-identified real data and expert rubrics is hard on data access and clinical expertise, but standard on engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Expert-crafted rubrics and access to de-identified clinical data could be hard to copy, though the site names no customers or data partners.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: General RL environment vendors were expanding in September 2025 per TechCrunch, and Alterra Labs raised a 12.5M seed for medical training environments in November 2026. No source shows any acting against Theora.

market_need_then: AI labs were buying RL environments in 2025 per TechCrunch, and Anthropic had reportedly discussed spending over 1B. Healthcare-specific demand for Theora is not independently documented.

branding.domain_note: Uses theorahq.com with an HQ suffix. The legal entity is Louiza, Inc. dba Theora.

identity.logo: not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Mission style, for example 'We teach AI how real-world medicine is done', with Designed in Boston and Engineered in San Francisco

branding.brand_signature: Medical school for AI agents framing

rebrands.why: Site shows Louiza, Inc. dba Theora; no source explains a rename or timing

brand_strength.rationale: The medical school framing is memorable, but the name is shared with the Theora video codec and other brands, and no brand press was found.

pivots.from: Auditable AI for pharmaceutical evidence (YC page, OpenEvidence for pharma)
pivots.to: Datasets and RL environments for healthcare AI agents (current site)
pivots.why: Not stated by any source; descriptions differ across YC and the company site

outcome_analysis: Theora is active, a three person Summer 2025 YC company whose description varies between pharma evidence AI and training environments for clinical agents. No funding, customers, acquisition or shutdown are verified. Direction appears to have moved toward the RL environment market that grew quickly in late 2025.
notes: No funding found; the site only says Backed by Y Combinator. Search results on seed rounds belonged to other companies (Health Universe, Alterra Labs, Amigo). The pivot entry is inferred from differing descriptions and its timing is unknown. Mechanize and Prime Intellect are dated from September 2025 coverage, close to but after the batch start.
